Thanks for contributing to FTPeach! Please read CONTRIBUTING.md first.

## What changed

<!-- A short summary of the change, from the user's point of view where possible. -->

## Why

<!-- The problem this solves. Link the issue it closes, if any: "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or improvement
- [ ] Translation
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring, tests or tooling (no change users will notice)

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, or the reason they are unnecessary is explained
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, server addresses or user data are included, in code, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] The user guide, docs and changelog describe the change, or the commits say why not (`Docs-Impact:` / `Changelog:` trailers, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] New or changed interface text is added to the locale files (English at minimum)

## Security

<!-- New IPC commands or capabilities, secrets, file paths or remote names need a security review (see CONTRIBUTING.md). -->

- [ ] This change does not touch IPC commands, capabilities, secret storage, or the handling of paths and remote names
- [ ] It does, and the description explains the impact
